title: CyberAlchemy Lab architecture selection

bound_owner_decisions.effect: Active product and specification naming is Craft or neutral while stable DS identifiers remain lineage IDs.
Lean evidence is a parallel non-blocking branch after semantic snapshot acceptance.

selected_architecture_properties: Machine records are canonical and checked-in human views are deterministic generated projections.
Artifact semantics, authority, ownership, schema, lifecycle, context, capability, Product, Project, module, package, and directory are orthogonal axes.
The full recursive envelope belongs to a capability instance; the whole repository form is not copied recursively.
Product and Governance are not inferred to be DDD Bounded Contexts.
Craft Product identity and Project coordination have separate carriers.
Active capability-instance authored and compiled source lives under specification/, not domainspec/.
Lean, Lake, craft-compiler, language, toolchain, runtime, environment, and lock declarations live in the platform plane; materialized local bytes live under ignored .cyberalchemy/ state.
CML-05/CML-06 and CML-07 branch independently from accepted CML-04 semantics according to explicit depends_on edges.
owner_role_posture: The role registry in CAL-PROP-0001 is selected as a separation-of-authorities contract; accountable identities may be bound later, and one person may hold multiple roles only without collapsing their distinct decisions or evidence.

selection_options.effect: Accept the exact architecture graph and allow CML-00 completion; CML-01 still requires a new routed execution authorization.
Return one or more exact proposal bytes for bounded revision; CML-00 remains blocked.
Keep the immutable candidate available but make no architecture selection.
Stop this selection process without accepting architecture or authorizing a successor.

claim_ceiling: This candidate presents exact architecture bytes for owner selection. Until CML00-ACCEPT is recorded, no architecture or path is accepted and CML-00 remains blocked. Selection would complete planning only and would not authorize CML-01, migration, implementation, installation, Git, publication, release, or deployment.
